title: Audible will speak a reason to try the next book.
friendlyTitle: Audible can speak a short reason to try the next book.
summary: Audible has launched audio discovery for select English-language titles in the United States. A short clip plays a narrated sample, an AI-generated overview of the themes and what listeners liked, and editor or author commentary taken from older Audible interviews. Ask a Question and spoiler-free Recaps are expanding to more US titles, with a broader rollout due in December, only for books you already have.
friendlySummary: Audible has added audio discovery for some English-language books in the United States. You hear a sample, a short AI overview of the themes and what listeners liked, and a comment from an editor or the author. Two other tools, questions and spoiler-free recaps, are spreading to more US titles in December, but only for books you already have.
whyItMatters: The clip is meant for a commute or a walk, when you will not scroll reviews. Audible says the overview draws on public synopses, metadata, and reviews. A summary of what people liked is not the complaints, so the sample is still the better check.
